input_reuse.reuse_scope: Semantic topology, coefficient projection, scenario history, and frozen P2-T02 policies are reused by hash; expected outputs are regenerated independently and are not copied from G4J.

reference_method.implementation: Independent Python reference producer using NumPy dense linear algebra; no ReactorSim.Core, G4J Program.cs, or G4J artifact import.
reference_method.mathematical_mapping: Construct the frozen two-group leakage/removal block A and fission-production block F, solve F*x=k*A*x by dense linear algebra, select the dominant finite positive eigenpair, and normalize flux to the frozen target power.
reference_method.algorithmic_independence: Direct dense generalized eigenvalue path; it does not use the Core/G4J source-iteration or Jacobi inner-solve implementation.
reference_method.runtime_dependency: Offline reference tool only; never a ReactorSim.Core or game runtime dependency.

authority_requirements.source_model_tool_build: Complete for the independent Python/NumPy reference producer; source commit is unavailable because the workspace has no Git HEAD and is bound by source and input hashes.
authority_requirements.nuclear_data: CandidateOnly_NoExternalLibrary: the project-authored synthetic reduced pack is reused by explicit hash; no external nuclear-data library is claimed.
authority_requirements.geometry_topology_mesh: Complete for the explicit 4-channel by 12-position 2x2 topology, 48 nodes, 92 reciprocal edges, and 104 boundaries.
authority_requirements.state_history_event_order: Complete for five scenarios, two S4 refuel shifts, prescribed RRS and bulk-poison branches, and explicit event history/order.
authority_requirements.units_conversions: Complete for declared SI coefficients, volumes, conductances, power, time, burnup, and energy-per-fission units.
authority_requirements.normalization_sign: Complete for the frozen P2-T02 positive-source, positive-power, caller target-power normalization and absorption-overlay signs.
authority_requirements.observable_schema_order: Complete for named k, group flux, node power, total power, residual, convergence, scenario, and canonical flat-index observables.
authority_requirements.independent_reproduction: Complete only when the independent producer regenerates byte-identical output and Core consumes frozen expected results; gate approval remains deferred.
authority_requirements.rights: Project-authored independent reference source, manifest, and candidate artifact; no external raw artifact or executable is redistributed.
authority_requirements.production_representativeness: Deferred: this task targets the selected ReducedModel runtime scope and does not claim direct external CANDU authority.

component_order_spec.canonical_sequence: channel_id ascending, position ascending, group index ascending (1 then 2)

observable_contract.comparison_rule: Core consumes the frozen independent expected artifact; G4 owns any approved quantity-specific tolerance.

tolerance.basis: P2-T05 quantity-specific profile identities and comparison semantics are bound, but no numeric threshold is selected by G4K. Observed differences and reference conditioning are evidence for G4-R6 review only.

spatial.k.evidence_basis: Dense generalized-eigen authority, Core five-case consumer, frozen P2-T02 convergence policy, and independent conditioning analysis; numeric approval deferred to G4-R6.

spatial.flux.evidence_basis: Dense generalized-eigen authority, canonical 48-node/group order, Core five-case consumer, frozen P2-T02 residual policy, and independent conditioning/spectral-gap analysis; numeric approval deferred to G4-R6.

spatial.power.evidence_basis: Power derived from independently normalized flux and frozen P2-T02 fission-power equation; Core five-case consumer and exact total-power normalization observed; numeric approval deferred to G4-R6.

spatial.total_power.evidence_basis: Independent target-power normalization and Core recomputation across all five scenarios; numeric approval deferred to G4-R6.

spatial.residual_relative_inf.evidence_basis: Independent matrix residual and Core frozen outer residual are recorded separately; observed cross-method residual difference is compared only after G4-R6 profile approval.

spatial.convergence.evidence_basis: Exact convergence-status/reason contract and frozen policy identity; G4-R6 owns approval of the complete discrete profile.

rights.redistribution: Allowed within this repository for bounded candidate validation; no third-party source or raw reference data is included.
